newsitem.title: USA: Is lofty US heating oil in 'backwardation vortex'?.
newsitem.headline: Is lofty US heating oil in 'backwardation vortex'?.

text.p: U.S. heating oil prices, soaring on historically lean inventories ahead of the winter, look likely to remain high, particularly for prompt material, industry sources said.

Sources cited a clear trend toward backwardation, or inversion, with firmer front end prices discouraging restocking efforts--which in turn increases the premium that prompt supplies are commanding over deferred barrels.
"The potential for a 'backwardation vortex' is there," said Tom Knight, a refined products trader at Fina Inc.
